solution: Training-only scores can be optimistic because the model may fit those particular examples. Held-out cases test prediction on unseen data and better reveal overfitting. They should represent relevant conditions and include difficult cases; a small or unrepresentative test set still gives uncertain evidence. Prefer a separate representative test set, review appropriate performance measures and investigate errors before deployment.
